decision: Designate a gold-star reference scenario so toolchain-validator can run its primary job
rationale: docs/meta-optimization/REFERENCE_SCENARIOS.md lists the gold-star reference as unset and development-toolchain-validator reference list returns 0 registered references. Without a target, the heartbeat cannot produce a validation scan; it will keep reporting BLOCKED until the operator nominates. Nomination rules in REFERENCE_SCENARIOS.md require state:active, clean score across toolchain tools, broad pattern coverage (API+CLI+UI+tests+CI), and ~60 days structural stability. Once nominated, also register in DTV via development-toolchain-validator reference create so validate/report commands (when shipped) have a handle.
notes: Operator nominated reference-react-vite on 2026-04-24 vision walk. Purpose-built reference scenario with full API+CLI+UI+docs+tests coverage — meets pattern-coverage requirement. Operator also noted in yesterday's checkpoint (friction #6) that toolchain-validator did not surface this obvious candidate; follow-up action: add 'enumerate candidate set' to prep-agent heuristics and improve toolchain-validator's awareness of reference scenarios.

decision: Trim swarm-manager-backlog-tools CLI Commands section (~258 lines, ~3K tokens) into a pointer at 'swarm-manager <group> --help' plus a short list of non-obvious usage notes
rationale: Baseline: skill is 527 lines / 27,565 chars / ~6,900 tokens; the CLI Commands section alone is 258 lines / 12,286 chars / ~3,000 tokens (44% of skill). Loaded by 19 inbound consumers (catalog-strategist, portfolio-manager, vision-walk-prep, director-swarm, monetization, morning-vision-walk, 13 swarm-manager-* skills). Health 0.51 with a 'skill content is oversized' warning. The swarm-manager CLI already has self-documenting help: 'swarm-manager backlog --help' lists every subcommand with flags; same for initiatives / captures / stats / agent-manager. The prose section duplicates that surface verbatim and drifts whenever the CLI adds commands (e.g., backlog workshop-reset, search-ai, review-decide already present in --help but require re-editing the skill to stay in sync). Expected delta: replace CLI Commands section with a one-paragraph pointer + a 15-20-line 'non-obvious usage patterns' block (stdin heredoc for file-upload, batch --preview before --execute, referential-integrity-is-automatic note, initiatives context as single-call loader). Estimated post-trim skill size: ~4,400 tokens (down from ~6,900, a ~36% reduction of the whole skill, ~80% reduction of the CLI section). Per-read savings: ~2,500 tokens × 19 consumers = compounding savings every time any of those skills is loaded. Measurement plan: (1) re-count chars/tokens after edit and log delta in PROGRAMMATIC_CONVERSION_QUEUE.md; (2) re-run graph health and confirm the oversized-content warning drops; (3) spot-check one downstream skill (e.g., swarm-manager-workshop) still has enough surface to do its job by tracing its CLI calls against the new pointer + --help output; (4) 14-heartbeat revisit to check for drift regressions or consumer complaints.
notes: Accepted 2026-04-24 vision walk. CLI self-documents via --help; prose duplicates and drifts. Replace CLI Commands section with pointer + 15-20 line non-obvious-patterns block. Measurement plan per decision rationale: log delta in PROGRAMMATIC_CONVERSION_QUEUE.md, re-run graph health, spot-check one downstream skill, 14-heartbeat revisit.

decision: Add TOOLS.md to agent quality-auditor and update agent.json fileOrder; surface the 11 steer skills already named in AGENTS.md as graph edges
rationale: Baseline: quality-auditor has health 0.56 (lowest among 21 agents; next lowest is 0.60). It is the only agent returned by 'prompt-manager graph skillless-agents'. Its folder holds only SOUL.md and AGENTS.md — no TOOLS.md. agent.json fileOrder is ['SOUL.md', 'AGENTS.md'], explicitly omitting TOOLS.md. AGENTS.md lines 26-38 name 11 specific skills as the steer-skill rotation it reads each cycle (Tier-1: screaming-architecture-audit, boundary-of-responsibility-enforcement, seam-discovery-and-enforcement, invariant-discovery-and-enforcement, cognitive-load-reduction, decision-boundary-extraction, code-cleanup; Tier-2 conditional: react-coherence, security, e2e-testing, documentation-health), but none appear as outbound graph edges. Graph node shows only 2 outbound edges (both cli:*). Peer agent programmatic-qa-runner in the same scenario-qa team has the full AGENTS/SOUL/TOOLS triad and scores 0.60 with 8 outbound edges (including bold-listed skill edges). Proposed change: (1) create scenarios/prompt-manager/store/agents/quality-auditor/TOOLS.md mirroring the programmatic-qa-runner pattern — 'Tool Access' block naming 'prompt-manager skill read <skill-id>' + 'Primary Skills' section listing all 11 rotation skills as bold-listed entries + 'Usage Rules' section restating the 'evidence with file paths + severity rating + bug-vs-improvement' rules that currently live in SOUL.md; (2) update agent.json fileOrder to ['SOUL.md', 'AGENTS.md', 'TOOLS.md'] and bump revision 1->2. Expected delta: removes quality-auditor from 'graph skillless-agents' (1 agent -> 0); adds ~11 outbound 'bold-listed' edges and potentially cli-read edges; outgoing-edges health factor moves from 0.40 toward 1.00 (matching programmatic-qa-runner); predicted health 0.56 -> 0.65-0.72. Measurement plan: (a) after merge, run 'prompt-manager graph node quality-auditor' and confirm >= 10 new outbound skill edges and new health score; (b) run 'prompt-manager graph skillless-agents' and confirm quality-auditor no longer listed; (c) update AGENT_AUDIT.md row with post-merge health; (d) 7-heartbeat revisit to verify no regression. Failure-mode check: not polishing (lowest health agent, concrete gap); not sprawl (editing existing agent, not creating new); not deprecation-too-fast (improving, not pruning); in-lane (agent-file edit only — no skill/scenario-code changes).
notes: Accepted 2026-04-24 vision walk. quality-auditor lowest-health agent (0.56) and only skillless one. Mirror programmatic-qa-runner pattern (SOUL+AGENTS+TOOLS). Expected lift 0.56 -> 0.65-0.72. Measurement per decision rationale: confirm skillless-agents goes to 0, edges >=10, update AGENT_AUDIT.md, 7-heartbeat revisit.

decision: Add tier-1 verification gate to run-introspector HEARTBEAT.md so errored runs with exit_code=429 and substantive completion text are reclassified as tier-5 misclassified-success, not investigated as real failures
rationale: Run 60116710-f77d-4c33-8058-2bd90c475289 is itself a successful agent-manager investigation run whose final report text (which mentions 'rate limit' dozens of times as a topic) tripped detectRateLimit's substring match at scenarios/agent-manager/api/internal/adapters/runner/claude_code.go:1518-1559, forcing ExitCode=429 on a clean exit. The report diagnoses its own misclassification (category Environment/Tooling, severity Critical) and names sibling false-positive e08357a4-87a9-4b16-b5ed-99c46aacc39d. Pattern verification: 2 of 22 FAILED runs (~9%) carry exit_code=429 + substantive markdown completion text rather than rate-limit banners, consistent with finding E1 in the run's own report. Without a tier-1 gate, run-introspector will keep picking these false positives as errored and drawing the wrong agent-behavior lessons. Proposed edit (team-agent-optimizer's lane): in scenarios/prompt-manager/store/teams/meta-optimization/members/run-introspector/HEARTBEAT.md 'Required Loop' step 3, after the ladder walk, add: 'If the candidate has exit_code=429 and error_msg is multi-paragraph / contains markdown headings (Summary, Classification, Report, etc.) rather than a rate-limit banner, skip as misclassified and continue the ladder.' This is an HEARTBEAT.md-only change — do not modify detectRateLimit itself (that is scenario-qa's lane on agent-manager code quality). Baseline: 2/22 false-positive rate today. Measurement: after edit, no future RUN_LESSONS.md entry should pick an exit_code=429-with-completion-text run as tier-1 errored. Revisit 2026-04-30 (7 heartbeats). In-lane check: proposes an agent-file edit by team-agent-optimizer (agent-improvement context), not a direct code change; fails neither sprawl, polishing, nor scope creep.
notes: Deferred, not disagreed. Revisit after 2026-05-01 (~7 heartbeats). detectRateLimit was recently addressed on the agent-manager side (scenario-qa lane); want to observe whether the underlying false-positive pattern (exit_code=429 + markdown completion text) still recurs before adding a redundant tier-1 gate in run-introspector HEARTBEAT.md. If run-introspector's own heartbeat continues to mis-pick such runs after 2026-05-01, it will naturally re-propose — which is the signal we want. Rejection here is a workaround for a missing 'deferred' status (captured as friction F12 — proper defer primitive to be filed as backlog item).
